name: evidence-lane-plugin
description: Human-governed project memory that preserves exact evidence, resumes unfinished work, and keeps acceptance under the user's control.

interface.shortDescription: Carry verified project knowledge across AI tasks without surrendering human control.
interface.longDescription: Evidence Lane is one universal plugin package with fifteen governed skills and a host-specific MCP connection. The complete package makes all fifteen skill entries visible on both ChatGPT and Codex, including Boot and locked ENV/UOP Flash guidance, accepted-PV Entry/Exit inspection, State Travel law, Mode, storage, and the exact six-control contract. Codex installs from exact Git source and can run the full local lifecycle: Source Intake, Build, Refresh, pointer-only Rollback, exact-APPROVE Fuse, plugin administration, and deployment evidence. ChatGPT Pro uses the same skill corpus with a registered 21-tool read profile for accepted-PV facts, ENV/UOP status, Entry and Exit Slips, Chat Lineage, lanes, search, diffs, backlog, and governed panels. On Pro, a skill whose requested action requires a lifecycle write must report the unavailable capability and stop; it may not simulate or claim the mutation. ChatGPT's native append-only ENV/UOP and Project Mutation workflow remains host-owned. The product name stays Evidence Lane while 1.4 remains version metadata. Meshy, generated GLB assets, and Meshy account linkage are not dependencies; the existing Three.js/WebGL website remains intact. Natural HIL intent never promotes a candidate, and only exact APPROVE may invoke Fuse on a write-capable governed host.
defaultPrompt: Boot Evidence Lane, verify ENV/UOP Flash, and show the six controls with host availability.
Show the accepted PV, Entry/Exit Slips, source lanes, and persistent plan without mutation.
Explain the current six-way HIL and exact next decision in clear business language.
